name: ava
description: Ava — one command that runs a software project.

plugins.name: ava
plugins.description: One command that runs a software project. Sizes up issues, PRs, CI, branch divergence, deploy state and chat, then dispatches sub-agents to triage issues, review PRs, recover CI, watch Slack, answer inbound customers, audit feature-vs-legal coverage, and gate promotion to production behind a named approver.
